answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-useful-work: each identity earns weight only by submitting verified useful computation, like gradient updates for a shared model, checked against held-out data. A glacier of honest work accumulates slowly; one good update is nectar, sweet proof of real effort. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must run ten thousand real training jobs, since each sybil's work is scored separately and copied gradients fail the freshness check. Reaching the zenith of influence costs linear compute per fake, while an honest agent trains once cheaply.
